# =============================================================================
# .github/sanitize-denylist.txt — Denylist for the sanitization scan
#
# Purpose:  Patterns checked for personal data in the validate.yml workflow.
#           This file contains ONLY generic patterns (regex) — no plaintext names.
#
# To extend with your own terms (without modifying this file):
#   Create local/sanitize-denylist-private.txt (gitignored).
#   The workflow also reads that file when it exists.
#   Format: one regex per line, comments with #, blank lines ignored.
#   Example:
#     MyClientName
#     my-project-name
# =============================================================================

# Usernames in paths (primarily macOS /Users/<name>)
# Allowed: /Users/Shared, no match on /Users/$USER or /Users/<var>
/Users/[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,}

# GitHub token prefixes
gho_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}
ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}
github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{80,}

# Private SSH key headers
-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----

# AWS key patterns
AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}

# Generic API key pattern (high false-positive rate — informational only)
# api[_-]?key\s*[:=]\s*["'][A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}["']
